title: Limits on Payment Relief and Due Day Moves Across the Auto Loans Products
content:
The limits below bound the relief that may be granted on a loan of the Auto Loans line. Each is a published figure of the product the borrower holds.

| Limit | Used Vehicle Loan | Certified Pre-Owned Vehicle Loan | Auto Refinance Loan | Lease Buyout Loan | New Vehicle Loan | Green Vehicle Loan |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Most installments one extension may defer | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 |
| Most extensions granted in any rolling 365 days | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 |
| Most extensions granted over the life of the loan | 4 | 4 | 4 | 3 | 6 | 6 |
| Whole months since funding before an extension may be granted | 6 | 6 | 6 | 6 | 6 | 6 |
| Scheduled installments that must have been paid before an extension may be granted | 6 | 6 | 6 | 6 | 6 | 6 |
| Most days past due a loan may be when an extension is granted | 59 | 59 | 59 | 59 | 59 | 59 |
| Due date changes allowed in any rolling window | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 |
| Largest move of the due day, in calendar days | 15 | 15 | 15 | 15 | 15 | 15 |

## Basis Q and A

**Where do the products differ?** On one row only. The lifetime extension limit reads 3 on the Lease Buyout Loan, 4 on the Used Vehicle Loan, the Certified Pre-Owned Vehicle Loan and the Auto Refinance Loan, and 6 on the New Vehicle Loan and the Green Vehicle Loan. Every other limit in this annex reads the same across the Auto Loans line.

**Are the rolling limit and the lifetime limit the same limit counted twice?** No. A borrower on a New Vehicle Loan may have taken 4 extensions over several years and still be inside the lifetime limit of 6, yet be outside the rolling limit if 2 of them fall in the last 365 days.

**Is the largest move of the due day a limit on where the day lands or on how far it travels?** On how far it travels: 15 calendar days in either direction from the day the loan currently falls due.

**Is the past-due limit a limit on status or on days?** On days. The figure published is 59 days past due, on every product of the Auto Loans line.
